lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: At the Beach. Peppa and her family are going to the beach. Peppa and George love going to the beach.
lines.zh: 在海边。佩奇一家要去海边。佩奇和乔治喜欢去海边。

lines.en: What a lot of stuff! We must be careful not to forget anything when we go. Sunshade, beach bag, towels, buckets and spades, and a spotty ball. Good! Now, before you start playing, you need some sun cream on.
lines.zh: 东西真多呀！我们走的时候一定要小心，别落下什么。遮阳伞、沙滩包、浴巾、小桶和铲子，还有一个圆点球。很好！现在，在你们开始玩之前，得先涂点防晒霜。

lines.en: The sun is very hot, so Peppa and George have to have sun cream on.
lines.zh: 太阳很晒，所以佩奇和乔治必须涂上防晒霜。

lines.en: Let's try out this spotty ball. It seems to work.
lines.zh: 我们来试试这个圆点球。看起来挺好用。

lines.en: What a great spotty ball!
lines.zh: 这个圆点球真棒！

lines.en: George, you throw the ball, and I will catch it.
lines.zh: 乔治，你来扔球，我来接。

lines.en: George! Catch! Oh, dear, George is too little to catch the ball.
lines.zh: 乔治！接住！哦，天哪，乔治太小了，接不住球。

lines.en: Never mind, George. Would you and Peppa like to have a paddle in the sea? Yes, please, Daddy! Let's put your water wings on.
lines.zh: 没关系，乔治。你和佩奇想去海里踩踩水吗？想，爸爸！来，把你们的游泳圈戴上。

lines.en: There we go! You look very smart in your water wings, George.
lines.zh: 好啦！乔治，你戴着游泳圈看起来真神气。

lines.en: My turn! My turn!
lines.zh: 轮到我了！轮到我了！

lines.en: Good, now we can play in the water!
lines.zh: 好了，现在我们可以在水里玩啦！

lines.en: Is the water cold? It's lovely and warm!
lines.zh: 水凉吗？暖暖的，舒服极了！

lines.en: You started it, Daddy Pig!
lines.zh: 是你先开始的，猪爸爸！

lines.en: Maybe that's enough splashing!
lines.zh: 也许打水仗该适可而止啦！

lines.en: Daddy, I love being at the beach! Peppa and George love the beach. Everyone loves the beach!
lines.zh: 爸爸，我喜欢待在海边！佩奇和乔治喜欢海边。大家都喜欢海边！

lines.en: Peppa, George, would you like to play with your buckets and spades? Yes, please, Mummy!
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，你们想玩小桶和铲子吗？想，妈妈！

lines.en: Daddy, Daddy, can we bury you in the sand? Uh, well... please, Daddy? No. All right! Yippee!
lines.zh: 爸爸，爸爸，我们能把你埋进沙子里吗？呃，这个……求你了，爸爸？不行。好吧！太好啦！

lines.en: Peppa and George are burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在把猪爸爸埋进沙子里。

lines.en: There! Now you can't escape! My head is getting a bit hot. Can I have my straw hat? Well, if you say please. Please, can I have my straw hat? Yes, you may, Daddy.
lines.zh: 好了！现在你跑不掉了！我的头有点晒得发热。能给我草帽吗？嗯，如果你说「请」的话。求你了，能给我草帽吗？可以，给你，爸爸。

lines.en: That's nice. Oh, maybe I'll just have a little sleep.
lines.zh: 真舒服。哦，也许我就这样小睡一会儿吧。

lines.en: George, let's make sandcastles! Peppa and George are making sandcastles. First, we put sand in the bucket, like this.
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来堆沙堡吧！佩奇和乔治在堆沙堡。首先，我们像这样把沙子装进桶里。

lines.en: We turn the buckets upside down and tap them.
lines.zh: 然后把桶倒过来，拍一拍。

lines.en: And lift the bucket up! Hey presto! A sandcastle!
lines.zh: 再把桶提起来！嘿，变！一座沙堡！

lines.en: Hey presto! Another sandcastle! Peppa, George, home time! Don't leave any stuff behind! Let's check that we haven't forgotten anything. Towels, beach bag, sunshade, and the spotty ball. That's everything!
lines.zh: 嘿，变！又一座沙堡！佩奇，乔治，该回家啦！别落下东西！我们检查一下有没有忘带什么。浴巾、沙滩包、遮阳伞，还有圆点球。全齐了！

lines.en: I'm sure we've forgotten something. Hmm.
lines.zh: 我肯定我们还忘了点什么。嗯。

lines.en: Of course, we forgot the hat!
lines.zh: 当然啦，我们忘了草帽！

lines.en: Daddy! We forgot Daddy!
lines.zh: 爸爸！我们把爸爸给忘了！

lines.en: Yes, we forgot Daddy Pig! Hey! What? Daddy, we almost left you behind, but George remembered you! Well, I'm glad George remembered me!
lines.zh: 是啊，我们把猪爸爸忘了！喂！什么？爸爸，我们差点把你落下了，是乔治想起了你！嗯，我很高兴乔治还记得我！
